The new entry I found tucked behind the others was dated March 25, 1972 and said... "A leaving asks a taking; the seam will not be satisfied without an offered place."

The seam caught the light and the glass answered... Then the seam was a midplane and the world tightened around it... There was a flutter... I was looking at the parlor from the wrong side of everything...

I pressed my forehead to the cool, unhelpful glass and watched the only proof I had of a bargain keep to its terms: Hannah, alive with my body, turned toward the street and took a step. Behind the glass my breath fogged the reflected pane; beyond it a woman moved off the mat toward a life that had cost me mine.
